description: Read the text content of any file in Google Drive by file ID. Supports Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Office formats (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx — auto-converted), and plain text files. Returns extracted text directly — no local filesystem needed.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

file_id.description: The Google Drive file ID to read

name: gws-mcp__drive_read_file
